fail.name: Elemental Cataclysm — Vulnerability
fail.desc: Vulnerability to the chosen damage type (Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning — edit to match your cast). The target repeats the Dex save at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect on a success. 1 minute.

success.text: Save succeeded — half damage, no Vulnerability.

automation.text: This **expends a spell slot** of the level set in your **Slot Level** counter — the action deducts the real slot from your spellbook (if you have none of that level, Avrae warns and continues). Set it first (e.g. `!cc "Slot Level" =3`); damage is **1d6 per slot level**. Choose a type (Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning) and edit `[fire]` in the roll and the Vulnerability type to match. 10-ft-radius Sphere within 60 ft of you.
